name: print-social-podcast-live-banner-set-white-with-orange-and-violet
title: Podcast banner set in white with orange and violet headlines, episode numbers and sound-wave strips
whatItIs: Six white square posts for a podcast: photos of hosts with headphones and mics in outlined notched frames, orange and black headlines ('Sunday Special Podcast', 'QnA Podcast Live Show Today!'), vertical 'Episode #255' labels, violet 'Start listening' buttons, name tags, squiggles and faint sound-wave strips.
whatItMeans: Lively and organised; the sound waves and episode tags make each post read as an audio show.
techniques: Add faint sound-wave strips as a texture.
Rotate the episode number vertically beside the photo.
Use name tags on guest photos.
Pair orange headlines with violet buttons.

vocabulary.definition: A graphic of audio amplitude bars.
A label with a person's name and role.
